name: StartupWorld

sources.title: Homepage — despite the name, now a coupon/deals site: '258,304 verified coupons from 14,470 stores'; stores get <store>.startupworld.com landing pages; Submit menu offers +Coupon/+Deal/+Review

Submit a Deal form — store name, deal URL (opt), title ≤255 chars, description ≥20 chars, expiry (opt), accuracy agreement; 'reviewed by our team before publishing'. Footer also exposes an 'Add Your Store' modal (store name, URL, affiliate signup URL optional, about optional)

requirements: The product must be able to offer a deal — this is a coupon/deals community site, not a startup news outlet (the 'Press' categorization in the source data is stale)
Deal submissions require: store name, deal title (≤255 chars), description (20-2,000 chars); deal URL and expiry optional
You must agree the deal 'is accurate and I have permission to share it'
An 'Add Your Store' form exists for store listing (store name, URL, optional affiliate signup URL)
Login/signup appears available but the deal form itself shows no auth requirement
preparation: A real discount or offer for the product (e.g., an extended trial, % off, lifetime deal)
Store name, website URL, deal title and description
Optionally an affiliate signup URL if the product runs an affiliate program
workflow: First get the store listed: use the 'Add Your Store' modal (footer link) with store name, URL, about text
Then open https://startupworld.com/submit/deal and submit the offer details
Wait for team review before the deal publishes
Optionally also submit via /submit/coupon if the offer has a code
watchFor: Name is misleading — this is a coupon aggregator (formerly a startup magazine); value is a store landing page + deal listing, not editorial coverage
Fake or unverifiable deals will fail review — the site advertises 'AI-tested' codes and shopper confirmations
Site earns affiliate commissions on links ('We may earn a commission') — expect affiliate-URL substitution on your deal links
Startup-friendly angle exists ('exclusive startup deals' tagline) and SaaS stores (Lovable, Manychat, Doola, Helium 10) are already listed
countsAsLive: The store has a public <store>.startupworld.com landing page and the deal/coupon appears in the deals feed
unknowns: Review turnaround and acceptance criteria for stores/deals
Whether a store page can be listed without an affiliate program
Link type and whether deal links get affiliate-wrapped
